source_direction.normal: normalize oriented source-triangle area sum in frozen source order
source_direction.interpolation: normalize source-ID keyed barycentric vertex-normal interpolation before feathering
source_direction.feature: exact nonzero barycentric source IDs, exact projected point and exact source-keyed weights
source_direction.ties: all nearest faces must identify the same feature; no fallback or averaging
source_direction.local_topology: connected manifold oriented incident fan; open boundary allowed

constraints.faces: all nearest faces retain their own projected point and oriented geometric normal
constraints.amplitude: one original positive lower endpoint of the complete feasible interval; no retry
constraints.realized: every retained face after saved-f32 and MHCLO text round trip
